# Scores by contact with the layer graph_neuronal adds (generated by experiments/score_by_layer_contact.py)

451 perturbation genes; 98 are in contact with the layer that data/processed/graph_neuronal adds to data/processed/graph (an incident edge the base graph lacks), defined from the graphs alone before any score was read. Out-of-fold predictions pooled across five disease-cluster folds; macro AUPRC over symptoms with at least 5 positives among the rows; paired bootstrap over perturbations (1000 resamples), 95 percent intervals, not corrected.

| genes | count | positive pairs | symptoms scored |
|---|---|---|---|
| genes in contact with the added layer | 98 | 209 | 9 |
| other genes | 353 | 652 | 9 |
| all genes | 451 | 861 | 9 |
